snippet.title: BULK - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ] [4K]
snippet.description:
BULK is a satisfying incremental game about turning endless piles of cards into pure profit. Welcome to your workplace, a dark fantasy factory where the machines never rest and the cards never stop. Grab cards from a conveyor belt, mix them with a magic device, and watch them rise in rank. Sell your cards for gold, then reinvest to make production faster, stronger, and a little more chaotic. Whether you love to click, optimize, or sit back and watch the numbers skyrocket, BULK delivers an incremental experience that blends active and idle gameplay with satisfying progression.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122620/BULK/
